metallb.io Layer 2: "layer 2 does not implement a load balancer." MetalLB only answers ARP/NDP for the IP; traffic goes to that node and kube-proxy spreads it across the service's pods. With no ready Traefik Pod there is nothing for kube-proxy to send to; staging chart default renders one replica (claim 1).
Opinion stated with its condition ('while one replica is down, the other carries all the traffic'); the lesson frames it as a consequence, not a rule. No documentation needed.
